name: JW Marriott Bucharest
positioning: JW Marriott Bucharest Grand Hotel: a 1980s building on Dealul Spirii hill beside the Palace of Parliament, with marble staircases, glass cupolas and a Balinese-inspired spa
best_for: Travelers who want a base near the Palace of Parliament, within walking distance of Old Town
Spa-goers drawn to a Balinese-inspired spa with private therapy suites

facts.text: The hotel is in close proximity to the Palace of Parliament and People's Salvation Cathedral.
The hotel is within walking distance of Bucharest's Old Town.
The hotel sits on Dealul Spirii hill and was built in the 1980s as part of the same urban plan as the Parliament Palace.
The lobby has warm colors lit by natural daylight, marble staircases and cupolas.
Rooms use a soft color palette accented with shades of blue inspired by the Danube River.
Rooms feature locally hand-crafted ceramic plates with traditional Romanian motifs and multifaceted mirrors.
The Presidential Suite has a fully equipped kitchen, a dining room and a round-shaped bedroom.
The Executive Lounge is on the hotel's top floor.
The daylit swimming pool has a green garden backdrop and is open year-round.
JW Steakhouse serves USDA Black Angus beef with wine and bourbon.
Under the Sta(i)rs is a lounge space set beneath one of the hotel's glass cupolas.
The Grand Avenue shopping gallery is on the hotel's ground floor.

highlights.text: THAIco SPA Grand is a Balinese-inspired spa with saunas, Vichy showers and suites with ritual baths.
The spa has two therapy suites, each with a private sauna, ritual bath and Balinese bed.
The Senator Suite has a corner layout with a round window looking out to the Parliament Palace.
A grand marble staircase sweeps from the entrance up to a light-filled cupola.
The Magic Table at JW Steakhouse is a multi-course dinner with 3D projections.

considerations.text: The hotel is about a 30-minute drive from Henri Coanda International Airport.
WhataHotel notes the large hotel size may feel less intimate.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
